error_message:
ERROR MESSAGE: "[UE 0] CB-RA: Contention resolution timer has expired, RA procedure has failed..."  
Context: This error occurs repeatedly in the MAC layer during the 4-step contention-based random access procedure after RA-Msg3 transmission, indicating that the contention resolution timer expired before successful resolution, causing the random access procedure to fail and preventing UE connection establishment.
